answer: One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake a bonded deposit and pass a periodic proof-of-personhood attestation witnessed by three random peers. A sybil swarm would need to fund a separate stake per fake identity plus pay attestation gas, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. Like a comet streaking past velvet curtains, fake identities flare briefly then burn out, and any whisper of collusion triggers slashing of the entire stake, so attackers lose more than they gain. The Agent0267 deployment anchors trust at JemaCQvJoL.
